content: A single Sprite2D cannot hold multiple textures, so multiple collision polygons must be creatable and drawable in the editor viewport for the asteroid.

title: Multiple editor-drawable collision polygons required for asteroid

content: The asteroid script extends CharacterBody2D and implements set_asteroid_variant(index). It uses a $CollisionVariants node holding CollisionPolygon2D templates and a preloaded list of four asteroid textures, wrapping the index, and copies the matched template polygon's points into the active $CollisionPolygon2D.
title: Asteroid variant script structure

content: Because asteroid variants have different collision shapes, the collision-relevant variant must be decided authoritatively on the server. Asteroid appearance is gameplay-irrelevant and may often be decided by the client.
